en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a dusty main street corner in a small town, showing a prominent two‑story stone commercial block with an American flag on the roof. The curved corner parapet reads "MIGLIAVACCA 1905 BUILDING." A bank occupies the street‑level corner entrance, with 'BANK' over the door and striped awnings over the windows. Upstairs windows display painted signs for professionals, such as attorneys and doctors. On the left side of the street are older one‑story storefronts, including a drugstore. Pedestrians in early‑20th‑century clothing walk in the unpaved street beside a horse‑drawn carriage, while overhead wires and a hanging streetlamp cross the scene.
